principles.rule: Manifest, runtime, release seal, worker identity, and canonical runtime tree agree before Engine paint.
Unverified route DOM never paints before route/release checks clear.
Project data, branding, media, orders, customers, settings, and authority are project-scoped by default deny.
Customer, Owner/Partner, Project Admin, Black Flag, Captain, and Admiral authority routes remain distinct.
Candidate and Last Known Good remain separate until deliberate Captain promotion.
Experimental length detection may abstain without suppressing proven orientation/species recognition.
Fleet-critical release files remain root-upload safe for the iPad/GitHub workflow.
Missing decorative route media cannot hold the Engine.

learned.lesson: Controlled camera height did not solve absolute length classification; customer distance is not a confidence requirement.
Shared experimental segmentation regressed Cedar and Horizontal recognition; detectors must be independently gated.
Stale service workers can blend releases; recovery visibly unregisters, clears app caches, installs, verifies identity, then reloads.
The iPad/GitHub web uploader did not reliably replace nested assets; fleet-critical files must be root-safe.
Missing Admiral ceremonial imagery held the Engine; decorative media is route-scoped, not fleet-critical.
